effective.basis: TCG release of the Machine Madness Value Box reprint of SDMM-EN003, the first printing carrying the PSCT text

transitions.historical_text: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, you can add 1 Union Monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can equip this card to a Machine-Type monster you control as an Equip Card, OR unequip it to Special Summon this card in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union Monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
transitions.modern_text: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Union monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only by equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
transitions.summary: PSCT rewording that keeps the Union Condition intact: a colon on the destruction-search Trigger, "You can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: ...", and the redundant "during your Main Phase" dropped from an effect that is an Ignition effect either way. The bracketed Union Condition and destruction substitution are still present (printed with the typo "can only by equipped"). Judged from the text lineage alone - no script diff exists for this card - so the spelled-out "Target" is read as PSCT codification, not a targeting change.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing without the Union Condition (SR10-EN006, Structure Deck: Mechanized Madness)

transitions.historical_text: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 Union monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it in face-up Attack Position. (A monster can only by equipped with 1 Union monster at a time. If the equipped monster would be destroyed, destroy this card instead.)
transitions.modern_text: When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the GY: You can add 1 Union monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. If the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.
transitions.summary: Functional erratum: the Condition "(A monster can only be equipped with 1 Union monster at a time.)" is deleted, so the modern Peacekeeper may equip to a Machine monster that already carries another Union monster, and the unequip mode loses its "in face-up Attack Position" requirement, letting the controller pick the battle position of the Special Summoned Peacekeeper. The destruction substitution is simultaneously narrowed in wording to "destroyed by battle or card effect".

coverage.gap_reason: Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode

gap.behavioural_impact: In an Edison snapshot EDOPro lets Machina Peacekeeper equip to a Machine monster that already carries another Union monster and be Special Summoned back in Defense Position, both of which the era's printed Union Condition and Attack Position clause forbid.

review.notes: upstream_implementations is empty; no goat or pre-errata variant of 78349103 exists upstream. Edison (2010-04-24) falls on v0 (SDMM-EN003, Machina Mayhem Structure Deck, 2010-02-19 EU / 2010-02-23 NA). Corroboration from EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata list, whose entry is titled "Machina Gearframe (and all Union Monsters)" and therefore covers Peacekeeper; quoted from the transcription in briefs/edison-functional-errata.md: "in Edison every Union Monster carries the Condition limiting a monster to 1 equipped Union Monster at a time". The site's attribution of the removal to the 2016 Structure Deck: Seto Kaiba is the community's own claim and is not used for chronology; this card's lineage dates the removal to SR10-EN006 (2020-04-16). cards.cdb matches v2 exactly. Note the lineage's v1 carries the printing typo "can only by equipped", which has no behavioural weight.
